name: FSLabs A319/A320/A321
description: FSLabs A32X family on MSFS. Reads the landing gear from the aircraft's own animation variables, which follow the actual gear rather than the handle.
notes: Taken from the FSLabs interior model behaviour file, which carries the cockpit and animation variables (FSLA320_gear_* run 0 fully up to 2000 fully down). That file does not expose the systems state — FCU selections and autopilot engagement are not in it — so those data points stay on the stock simulation variables until the FSLabs systems variable list is wired in.
